name: Artificial Intelligence
benefit: UCOST, Regional Science Center, Dehradun, in collaboration with Intel, has established an AI Skills Lab under the AI for Youth program. Students from classes 9 to 12 across the state can participate in AI coding camps and perform hands-on experiments.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a student of class 9 to 12 studying in a government or private school in Uttarakhand.
